races.paceDynamic: Poetic Twist will lead from the start with no other confirmed pace-setters in this 18-runner field, allowing Gordon Elliott's mare to dictate a comfortable rhythm over the testing 2m1f trip. The lack of early pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where positions behind the leader become crucial, with prominent racers like Echinacea, Mind The Steps and Crystabel likely to track the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the modest early gallop and finish strongly, with Poetic Twist also well-placed if she can sustain her advantage. The tactical nature and lack of pace pressure creates ideal conditions for closers and hold-up performers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Twist maintains a steady gallop without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to stay strong late while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing soft ground. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit from the honest tempo and superior position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks over the final 3-4 furlongs. The tactical nature plays into the hands of those with natural acceleration from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners decide to pressure Poetic Twist from the 6th furlong
scenarios.body: The race develops into a genuine staying test where only horses with proven stamina can cope. This scenario eliminates the pure hold-up horses but also tests the leader's reserves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Twist goes too slowly and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where positioning and luck in running become crucial factors. Horses drawn wide or those that get interfered with suffer most.

watchPoints.text: Poetic Twist sets fractions that are too slow early and gets swamped by the field in the home straight
Multiple lightly raced horses including Holly's Thunder and Howaya Codge could be significantly better than their profiles suggest
Echinacea switching from all-weather flat racing to hurdles represents the biggest form variable in the race
Several horses including Urinmydreams and Lost Features returning from lengthy absences may lack race fitness
The 7lb claiming riders on Tullyegan Jet, Dictionary Corner, Its All Yellow and Idomything could provide crucial weight advantages in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Butterfly Mountain is the lone confirmed front runner and will get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop on this soft ground. Master Haku, Appy Getaway, Bulgaden Castle and Minella Mate will track the leader in the prominent positions, while a large group of hold-up horses including Small Fry, Loyal Touch and Ancient Myth will be held back for late challenges. With only one natural leader against 17 others, this creates a classic scenario where the pace will be steady early before quickening significantly from the last hurdle. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts, as the hold-up brigade may find too much to do against the uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trackers can stay within striking distance of Butterfly Mountain's uncontested lead.
scenarios.body: Master Haku and Appy Getaway are perfectly positioned to pounce when the pace quickens, having the class and tactical speed to close the gap. The hold-up horses will be caught flat-footed by the sudden acceleration from what appeared a steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Success
scenarios.trigger: If Butterfly Mountain's 365-day absence doesn't tell and the pace stays truly manageable throughout.
scenarios.body: The leader maintains a soft lead on ground that suits, with the prominent runners unable to quicken sufficiently and the hold-up horses left with too much to do. Jack Kennedy on Master Haku may have waited too long to challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes even steadier than expected, creating a sprint finish from the last hurdle.
scenarios.body: Small Fry and Loyal Touch time their challenges to perfection, with Joseph O'Brien's charge benefiting from the strongest finishing kick. The prominent runners get caught for speed having been positioned too close to a crawling pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the occasion or jumping pressure in a competitive maiden field.
scenarios.body: Cullagh Lad or another unexposed type produces a career-best performance, taking advantage of the tactical battle ahead of them. The favourites either make crucial jumping errors or get caught up in traffic problems.

watchPoints.text: Butterfly Mountain's jumping under pressure - 365 days off and poor recent form makes a mistake likely when challenged.
Master Haku's fitness after 145 days off - Elliott's runners often need their comeback runs despite obvious class advantage.
The pace through the early stages - if Butterfly Mountain goes too fast early, it opens the door for hold-up horses.
Traffic problems in running - 18 runners with many hold-up types could create a messy finish if the pace collapses.
Small Fry's jumping fluency - returning after 497 days and needs to be sharp over hurdles to utilize his finishing kick.

races.paceDynamic: Becasse will lead from the front with Wholelotofbusiness and She Is Electric likely to track prominently early. With no other confirmed pace-setters in this 14-runner field, the front three should get an uncontested lead through the early stages. The soft ground will test stamina reserves as they turn for home, but the moderate early pace means the leaders won't burn themselves out. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early pace-setters who can sustain their effort, as the hold-up horses will face a wall of traffic in a large field on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Becasse and Wholelotofbusiness get uncontested early positions without pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain their advantage through moderate fractions and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. Hold-up horses get caught behind the large field and struggle to make late ground on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Quality Hold-Up Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race and the early leaders come back to the field
scenarios.body: Arch Empire and High Court Cave benefit from a stronger pace as the prominently-raced horses tire on the soft ground. The Gordon Elliott stable's tactical awareness helps Arch Empire time his challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Upset from Handicappers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Piccolo Player and Give Him A Chance benefit from their low weights and get strong runs through gaps. The race becomes tactical enough for their hold-up styles to be effective despite the large field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Traffic Issues
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make simultaneous moves turning for home creating interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with several horses hampered by traffic problems in the large field. Sopelana's young legs and Positive Energy's amateur rider navigate cleanest routes to the finish.

watchPoints.text: Becasse could get loose on the lead if no other horse goes with him early, making him very difficult to catch
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 14 runners on soft ground as hold-up horses seek racing room simultaneously

Piccolo Player running 24 hours after previous race may show effects of quick turnaround in testing conditions

races.paceDynamic: Shadys Lady will lead unchallenged early with no genuine pace pressure, creating a controlled tempo over 2m5½f on testing soft ground. The tactical battle develops behind as Carry On Heidi, Joshua's Daylami, Katie Daniels and Ladiam all want prominent positions, creating congestion and scrimmaging 2-3 out when the race begins in earnest. The hold-up horses - Dameauscottlestown, Cobra Queen, Elsannah, Maxios Prime and Andyourbirdcansing - face a wall of traffic as the prominent brigade fans across the track. This race shape strongly favours the leader and prominent runners who can secure clean jumping room early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Soft
scenarios.trigger: If Shadys Lady maintains her jumping and stays the extended trip
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace suits her perfectly and she builds an unassailable lead turning for home, with the prominent runners scrapping for places behind. Her front-running style thrives when not pressured early over this stamina-testing distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet settle into a rhythm behind Shadys Lady without excessive early pace
scenarios.body: Carry On Heidi, Katie Daniels or Joshua's Daylami can track the leader cleanly then pounce when she weakens, avoiding the traffic chaos further back. The winner emerges from this group who travel best through the race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Navigation
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse finds a clean passage through the inevitable traffic
scenarios.body: Dameauscottlestown or Cobra Queen can weave through the carnage with superior class, but they need the leaders to come back to them significantly. The winner must have both the ability and racing room to mount a challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Shadys Lady stops suddenly and the prominent runners all get into trouble simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with any horse getting a clear run able to pick up the pieces, but this requires multiple things to go wrong for higher-rated runners. Unlikely given the quality of several prominent runners.

watchPoints.text: Carry On Heidi, Katie Daniels, Joshua's Daylami and Ladiam will create a four-way battle for prominent positions behind the leader, causing inevitable interference.
Shadys Lady's stamina over 2m5½f is questionable given her front-running style, watch for her jumping to deteriorate if the trip stretches her.
Dameauscottlestown and Cobra Queen need the leaders to come back significantly but may struggle to get clear racing room through traffic.
Joshua's Daylami carries 362 days off the track despite having Jack Kennedy aboard, his fitness must be taken on trust.
The soft ground conditions favour several runners but will test stamina reserves over this extended trip, particularly for the early leaders.

races.paceDynamic: Made In The Woods will take the field along as the sole natural front-runner, with It's Time Again, Mr Dibbs, Joe's Turn and Max Time settling prominently behind. The pace will be controlled and sustainable with no obvious pressure for the lead, allowing the tempo to steady through the middle sections. This creates a tactical setup where the prominent racers can track the pace comfortably before the hold-up horses launch their challenges up the home straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can stay close to the pace without expending energy, as they'll be ideally positioned when the kick comes.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Made In The Woods sets a steady pace without pressure and the prominent horses track smoothly
scenarios.body: The controlled tempo allows It's Time Again, Mr Dibbs and Joe's Turn to conserve energy while staying close to the pace, giving them first run on the hold-up brigade. These prominent racers can quicken from ideal positions while the back-markers face a wall of horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly sedate and the field bunches up approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: The compressed field creates gaps for the stronger hold-up horses to exploit, with Dolly Watkins and Ranger Billy having the class to quicken decisively. Their fresh legs tell in a driving finish as the pace-trackers tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Made In The Woods faces no sustained pressure and gets an easy lead throughout
scenarios.body: The combination of light weight (147lbs) and uncontested lead allows Made In The Woods to dictate completely and resist late challenges. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground against a horse who has controlled every yard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fading Finishers Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners hit the front too early and multiple hold-up horses fade as usual
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with early leaders stopping and natural finishers failing to fire. This chaos allows a forgotten hold-up horse with stamina to emerge from the pack.

The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will build gradually, with the real racing beginning from the final mile as the army of hold-up horses start their challenges. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Lucky Cailin gets an easy lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for the hold-up brigade to make up ground, allowing the leader to control the race and kick clear when it matters. With soft ground suiting stamina types, a sustained gallop from the front proves most effective.
